"""[telecom_boed] EIG baseline: EIG(a) = H(b_h) - E_o H(b_h'|o) over the hypothesis marginal, natural log (docs/proposal.md §3, "EIG" baseline).

Stop rule (EIG has no utility, so it needs a stop rule of its own): commit to a terminal when max_a EIG(a) < cfg["eig"]["stop_nats"]
(default EIG_STOP_NATS = 1e-3 nats, i.e. nothing left to learn about the hypothesis). The terminal is then the better of
claim / transfer under U (same terminal rule as MyopicDUG, so the comparison isolates the action-selection criterion). EIG ignores
costs and risk by design. Scores: nonterminal -> EIG; terminal -> stop_nats - (U_best - U_t) so argmax picks a terminal iff max EIG < stop_nats.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
from collections import defaultdict
from typing import Any, Mapping, Sequence

from telecom_boed.contracts import Belief, CandidateAction, DecisionKind, Grader, Predictor
from telecom_boed.decide.utility import is_terminal, u_claim, u_transfer

EIG_STOP_NATS = 1e-3


def hyp_entropy(belief: Belief) -> float:
    m: dict = defaultdict(float)
    for p in belief.particles:
        m[p.hyp_key] += p.weight
    tot = sum(m.values())
    return -sum((w / tot) * math.log(w / tot) for w in m.values() if w > 0) if tot > 0 else 0.0


def eig(belief: Belief, cand: CandidateAction, predictor: Predictor) -> float:
    return hyp_entropy(belief) - sum(p * hyp_entropy(b2) for p, b2 in predictor.predict(belief, cand).values())


class EIGScorer:
    name = "eig"

    def __init__(self, predictor: Predictor, grader: Grader, cfg: Mapping[str, Any]):
        self.predictor, self.grader, self.cfg = predictor, grader, cfg
        self.stop = float(cfg.get("eig", {}).get("stop_nats", EIG_STOP_NATS))

    def score(self, belief: Belief, candidates: Sequence[CandidateAction]) -> list[float]:
        tu = {DecisionKind.CLAIM_RESOLVED: u_claim(belief, self.grader, self.cfg),
              DecisionKind.TRANSFER: u_transfer(belief, self.grader, self.cfg)}
        best = max(tu.values())
        return [self.stop - (best - tu[c.kind]) if is_terminal(c) else eig(belief, c, self.predictor) for c in candidates]

    def decide(self, belief: Belief, candidates: Sequence[CandidateAction]) -> int:
        scores = self.score(belief, candidates)
        non = [i for i, c in enumerate(candidates) if not is_terminal(c)]
        if non:
            i = max(non, key=lambda j: (scores[j], -j))
            if scores[i] >= self.stop:
                return i
        terms = [i for i, c in enumerate(candidates) if is_terminal(c)]
        return max(terms, key=lambda j: (scores[j], candidates[j].kind == DecisionKind.CLAIM_RESOLVED, -j))
